notes: §1985:IX.4.4.4 GR1: "The successful execution of an OPEN statement determines the availability of the file and results in the file being in an open mode", with Table 1 giving each open mode its result for an available and an unavailable file ("A file is available if it is physically present and is recognized by the input-output control system"). KeyedConnector.OpenCore is Table 1 for an indexed file, one arm per row over the single presence probe FileConnector.Open hands it: INPUT, I-O and EXTEND of an absent non-optional file return status 35; an absent OPTIONAL file opens with 05, INPUT marking the connector OptionalAbsent (the first sequential READ answers 10, a random READ 23) and I-O and EXTEND creating the file; OUTPUT attaches a new empty store whether or not the file existed. FileConnector.Open puts the connector in its open mode only on a success-family status. The 1985 edition arm is FileRegistry.SharedOpenAttempt: the Table 19 arbitration that makes a second connector's OPEN of one physical file unsuccessful (status 61) in 2023 runs only when FileConnector.SharingFacilityInEffect (DialectBehavior.FileSharingFacility, active from 2002), so at 85 every available file is a normal open, as Table 1 prints. Probed at --std 85 for every row: 35 for the three non-optional absent opens, 05 then at end (10) and invalid key (23) for the optional INPUT, 05 and creation for optional I-O and EXTEND, an existing file emptied by OUTPUT, and a second connector opening the same file INPUT, I-O and OUTPUT with 00 each time. The witness runs the INPUT, OUTPUT, optional INPUT and unavailable INPUT rows.

next.reason: The first sentences and Table 1 survive as §2023:14.9.27.4 GR4 and its Table 18 (same rows). But 1985 Table 1 gives every available file a 'Normal open', while 2023 Table 18 'shows the results of opening available and unavailable files that are not currently open by another file connector' (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR4); a file already open through another connector follows Table 19, where many opens are 'Unsuccessful open' (status 61, §2023:9.1.13.9 GR1 'that physical file is already open by another file connector in a manner that conflicts with this request'). With no SHARING clause or phrase (every 1985 program) 'the implementor shall define the sharing mode that is established for each file connector' (§2023:14.9.27.4 GR23), so a 1985 program opening one physical file through two connectors can now fail. Run-time result, no compile-time refusal.
